Air Asia Buds Adventures S1E1 -High-Flying Fun!
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, & learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok & the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, & discovery.

programme.title: E3 - Fun Nature Discoveries!
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he & D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made & join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science & new friends!

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E1 -Yummy! It's Mealtime
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers make mealtime a delicious discovery. Through stories and songs, kids explore the joy of eating, practice mealtime routines, and learn when to use forks and spoons.

programme.title: E6 - A Very Happy Birthday!
programme.desc: Join Cody for a fantastic birthday adventure at Dinoland! Afterward, ride the bus with his family, play peek-a-boo, and welcome his new baby sister, Kendi. It's a day of family fun, games, and sweet surprises.

programme.title: E4 - A Magical Sky Adventure!
programme.desc: Go on a magical sky adventure with Twinkle! First, discover the variety of cloud shapes & sizes, from triangles & squares to star-shaped clouds! Then, daydream high in the clouds with Twinkle & Mr. Moon, where her magical stardust makes the moon sneeze & keeps changing colors! The sky-high fun continues as Twinkle soars through the sky on a magical journey to explore all the vibrant colors of the rainbow.

programme.title: E1 - Let's Play All The Best Games!
programme.desc: It's time to play all the best games with Kii & Yii! The fun begins with a high-stakes game of Red Light, Green Light, where Jeepbot is 'It' with a slime cannon blaster! Then, Kii & Yii play a fun game of life-size Snakes & Ladders, complete with toy snakes & big ladders. The competition continues with a game of Duck, Duck, Goose in mini race cars & a summer pool party game of Marco Polo with Snappy Croc!

programme.title: E7 - JJ's Birthday Celebration
programme.desc: It's the night before JJ's birthday and he is too excited to sleep! Join the fun with a game of musical chairs, a party at the farm with animal friends, and lots of special gifts. Will everything be ready in time for the big day?

programme.title: E13 - A Birthday Full of Surprises!
programme.desc: It's a day of celebrations with Baby John! First, it's his birthday with cake and presents. Then, he accidentally ruins his sister Jill's spa party. Finally, he uses his imagination to travel to a prehistoric world for Dino's birthday!

programme.title: E1 - Central Australia
programme.desc: In this first episode, we showcase the best experiences on offer in Central Australia, also known as ‘The Red Centre.’ This ancient land is brimming with natural wonders and cultural significance. See Uluru at sunrise, experience life as a cattle farmer, learn about Australia’s rich indigenous history and walk the treacherous Larapinta Trail.

programme.title: E10 - Southern Western Australia
programme.desc: From the towering Karri forests of Warren National Park to the ancient rock formations of The Pinnacles, Western Australia’s southern region is a treasure of natural wonders. In the final installment of Experience Australia, we highlight the best experiences for visitors to this magical region. Explore the pristine coastline and cuddly wildlife residents of Rottnest Island, immerse yourself in an indigenous cultural experience at Yanchep National Park, and embark on a thrilling sea voyage to encounter the elusive killer whale.

programme.title: E7 - Don and Kelly With Sherryl
programme.desc: Don and Kelly are looking for a small home for themselves and a large piece of land for their ten Canadian Eskimo dogs.

programme.title: E2 - Northern Territory
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: E1 - Plane Crashes
programme.desc: Aviation is one of the safest forms of travel—until something goes terribly wrong. This episode of Fatal Engineering dives deep into the stories behind some of the most devastating plane crashes in modern history. Through expert analysis, recreations, and insider accounts, we uncover how small design flaws, rushed procedures, and ignored warnings contributed to catastrophic failures. Discover what really brought these aircraft down—and how those tragedies led to life-saving innovations.

programme.title: E433
programme.desc: C'EST LA VIE: C'est La Vie focuses on the real experiences of ordinary people amid the tide of the times. Through in-depth interviews and observational filming, it presents a vivid social visual archive of contemporary China with authentic life stories. With profound humanistic care and compelling narrative tension, it has earned widespread acclaim and numerous awards both at home and abroad, establishing itself as a benchmark in Chinese-language documentaries. Continuously conveying warmth and strength, it inspires viewers to reflect deeply on humanity and destiny.

programme.title: E511
programme.desc: HONG KONG PERSPECTIVES: Hong Kong Perspectives is a Cantonese-language programme. Through interviewing people from different walks of life and key figures in major events, the programme provides viewers with an in-depth understanding of Hong Kong. Staying close to public sentiment and targeting hot topics of social concern, it dissects Hong Kong's current affairs and future prospects from political, economic, livelihood, and cultural perspectives, examining them with varying degrees of depth and perspective.

programme.desc: On the programme: Marie-Laure and Arnaud Gabriel, makers of handmade sorgo brooms; green waste; the gardens of the Domaine de la Garenne Lemot, Italy revisited; Don't panic with Sophie and Olivier.

programme.title: E12 - Maison Des Canuts/Sarah Valente/Thibaut Thierry
programme.desc: The Maison des Canuts traces the long tradition of Lyon's gold, silver and silk weavers. Each creation by visual artist Sarah Valente sounds like a call from the forest. Zomer is turning fashion upside down. In Brittany, craftsman Thibaut Thierry works paper with seaweed.

programme.title: E2 - Stephane Rolland
programme.desc: His runway shows are steeped in feelings and emotion. Stephane Rolland has chosen bliss as the theme for his new spring-summer 2024 haute couture collection, which also pays tribute to the East.

programme.title: E5 - Eyes In The Skies
programme.desc: An amateur astronomer, Michel Ory has a passion: hunting asteroids and comets. He is the only living Swiss citizen to have discovered two comets, and is credited with the discovery of hundreds of asteroids. A luminous quest that takes us from Switzerland to Morocco.

programme.title: E10 - Collectors
programme.desc: Collectors' passion grows over the years, sometimes turning into obsession. In these very closed circles, members know each other and interact. Most are discreet, often reluctant to reveal their treasures. Others agree to share them...

programme.title: E5 - Provencal Daube
programme.desc: Annick Jeanmairet and Brigitte Rosset offer you a recipe for Provencal daube. Discovery of the day: white wine tart.

programme.title: E9 - Belgian Chic
programme.desc: First stop at the Zoute Grand Prix, where the cars shine brighter than the sun. Collectors bring out their exceptional cars to make them purr along the seafront. A change of altitude and a stopover in Les Gets, with Michelin-starred chef Christophe Pauly. Finally, Paris, Fashion Week and Facon Jacmin.

E8
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: From Riches To Rags
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor...

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: In a moment of irresponsible negligence, sharp-tongued barrister Adrian Lam mishandles a child abuse case and indirectly sentences the innocent Jolene Tsang to prison for 17 years. Falling from disgrace, Adrian decides to serve the public and defend the commoners, until an unlikely opportunity for appeal surfaces. Determined to right his wrong, Adrian gathers former partners Evelyn Fong and Prince to free Jolene, but that would mean fighting against the tycoons, Victoria and Desmond Chung, who also have barrister James Tung as their private consultant. With pressure from media and police, and facing tough cross examination from prosecutor Kam Yuen Shan in court, how will Adrian uphold justice and punish the true culprit?
